subject: Cross-cloud bundle pricing and reseller margin proposal
messages:
From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@zencorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-cloud private offer: bundle pricing for APAC pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved Redwood's latency profile. We're preparing an APAC pilot and would like a single private-offer that covers both AWS and GCP consumption for a single SKU (to simplify our internal procurement).

Questions we need answered to move forward:  
- Can Redwood issue a single PO that maps to two marketplace SKUs (AWS + GCP) under one commitment?
- What's the maximum discount stack you can support when combining a multi-cloud commit + an enterprise reseller pass-through? We need to model gross-to-net for our finance team.
- For channel margin: do you support an explicit waterfall so our reseller (Pacific Cloud Partners) can receive a fixed % on net? Or is it a list-price pass-through?

I've attached our RFP (Zenco_RFP_Q2.pdf) for context. Procurement@zencorp.com is looped on the thread. Target to approve the PO by end of May.

Appreciate a clear breakdown (table) we can share with finance.

Best,
Maria
Maria Sanchez
Head of Cloud Platform
Zenco Inc

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@zencorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud private offer: bundle pricing for APAC pilot

Maria — thanks for the RFP and for the clear ask. High level answers up front, then I'll attach a pricing table.

1) Single PO: Yes, we can accept one PO and configure a private-offer package that maps to multiple marketplace SKUs. We'll coordinate with AWS and GCP ops to ensure usage attribution flows to the same commitment.

2) Discount stacking: We support an ordered discount waterfall. Typical structure is: base public list -> Redwood enterprise discount (commit level) -> reseller commission (pass-through) -> final rebate/retro (if triggered). The maximum stack depends on total commit size and term; for pilots we usually cap combined stack at ~35% list for a 12-month small pilot, but this is negotiable for larger commits.

3) Channel margin: We can build an explicit waterfall so Pacific Cloud Partners receives a fixed percentage on net revenue. Alternate option is list-price pass-through if that fits your reseller accounting.

I'm attaching an initial spreadsheet (redwood_crosscloud_pricing_v1.xlsx) with two scenarios: minimal pilot and scaled 12-month commit. Quick ask from my side: can procurement share target gross-to-net % (Zenco's expected spend after reseller margin) so we can reverse-engineer the offer?

I'll loop in Karthik (pricing lead) and Lauren (sales ops) to finalize.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Cloud
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_crosscloud_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing table: pilot vs commit scenarios)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Forwarding Zenco's RFP — they want a single PO that covers AWS + GCP SKUs and a reseller waterfall to Pacific Cloud Partners. Key asks: single PO mapping, clear discount stack, and an explicit % to reseller. Procurement deadline end of May.

Notes for pricing:  
- Pilot size: ~$120k ARR equivalent across clouds for first 3 months, scale to $600k ARR if pilot converts.
- APAC legal requires local invoicing in SG for timeframe; look into marketplace invoicing mechanics.
- Customer prefers fixed-percentage reseller commission, not dynamic pass-through.

Can you advise max discount we can give for pilot vs commit? Also any marketplace contract traps for cross-cloud combined PO?

Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@zencorp.com>, procurements@zencorp.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud private offer: bundle pricing for APAC pilot

Ben — copied in a proposed waterfall and two concrete scenarios. I'll summarize here and attach the calculation sheet in the CRM record.

Proposed waterfall (ordered application):
- List price (per-cloud SKU)
- Redwood enterprise discount (applied to list)  -> conservative pilot: 18% | scaled commit: 28%
- Reseller fixed commission (Pacific Cloud Partners) -> pilot: 12% of net | scaled: 10% of net
- Final retro/rebate (conditional on attainment) -> up to 5% (only for scaled commit)

Net math (example pilot): list $150k combined -> enterprise discount 18% = $123k -> reseller 12% = $108.24k -> effective gross-to-net for Zenco = 28% off list. We're capping combined stack ~30-32% for pilots so we preserve unit economics.

Marketplace/PO mechanics: we should not attempt to fake a single SKU in the marketplace. Instead: create a master private-offer with a single commitment agreement (Redwood legal) and map the private-offer to two marketplace serials so usage attribution is split but billing is consolidated to the master commitment. This avoids marketplace SKU reconciliation issues. For APAC invoicing, recommend Redwood issues a consolidated invoice to Zenco Singapore entity and passes marketplace settlement to AWS/GCP on backend. Will need Marketplace Ops (cc'd) to confirm technical steps.

Action items:
- Ben: get Zenco's target gross-to-net % (they said they'll share).
- Lauren: prepare PO language template and reseller commission clause.
- Karthik: I'll draft the formal waterfall and two SOW price points.

-Karthik
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference

Maria
